scope: Static local LIRO analysis; no hardware
method: prior local Ghidra evidence only where explicitly noted

findings.finding: RelMgr constructs and sends type-0 ObjMsg 0x3015 through 0x43aeaee2.
No receiver/adaptor proves that 0x3015 reaches the local dispatcher or cancels an installed capture.
Non-install branches invoke state helpers, including 0x43b01a20 with 0/1 and tail calls to 0x43b01f36/40/7c; their semantic effect is unresolved.
Only local message 0x100 directly calls 0x43807d80; adjacent local message cases use other handlers.

findings.method: LLVM plus prior local pseudocode cross-check
findings.finding: LIRO stage returns 0/1/2/5 and conditionally calls 0x437fbad8 on ctx+0x754 before zeroing that field; normal path repeats this cleanup and calls 0x43787180.
The helper-plus-zeroing pattern likely detaches a request/stage slot, but field type, ownership and idle semantics are unknown.

findings.method: LLVM Thumb, entries normalized from Thumb pointers
findings.finding: LIRO state dispatches route to stage functions and return 5 for out-of-range state; this is not proof of capture completion.
No proven idle transition, DMM allocation release, or mapping of stage returns to cancellation/success was recovered.
DmmClose is not allocation release; it decrements unit+0x2a1 and cannot establish buffer release here.
A pre-descriptor abort is a candidate safe window, but no release event is linked to it and no pre-curtain guarantee is proven.

safety: Static read-only analysis only; no original binary or Ghidra project modified, no camera interaction or flashing; SilentShutter is not declared functional.
